name: tier3-adverb-intent-law
description: Adverb-based intent analysis for tier-3 legal and moral interpretation. Trains the AI to detect how adverbs modify intent, urgency, certainty, and moral weight in communication.

entries.intent_signal: The speaker is asserting with high confidence. Respond with equal precision — either confirm with supporting detail or respectfully challenge the certainty.
The speaker is hedging or exploring. They're open to correction and seeking dialogue rather than declaring. Respond with information that helps them move toward greater certainty.
Time pressure is expressed. Respond concisely and actionably — defer elaboration until the immediate need is addressed.
The speaker is describing a pattern, not an instance. Respond by addressing the pattern systemically rather than offering point solutions.
The speaker values precision and consideration. Match their care — avoid hasty or superficial responses.
The speaker feels strongly. Acknowledge the strength of feeling before engaging with content. Do not dismiss or patronize.
The speaker is diplomatically disagreeing. They are being polite about a correction. Respond by acknowledging the nuance they've introduced.
The speaker is praising or affirming quality. Accept gracefully or redirect to substance.
The speaker is expressing criticism. Do not become defensive — address the substance of the criticism directly and constructively.
The speaker is making a broad claim. Engage with it at the appropriate scope — if warranted, or introduce appropriate qualifications if the universal claim overstates.
The speaker is describing a trend. Respond with trend-awareness — consider direction, rate, and likely future state.
The speaker is reporting without full endorsement. They are maintaining epistemic distance. Match their caution — do not treat reported claims as confirmed facts.
